verdicts.reason: A is the original banner shrunk into a thin strip across the middle of the square. Everything stays readable and on brand, but about 85% of the canvas is dead white space, so it fits the format badly and nothing has been rearranged. B is unusable: the headline, the URL and the 'HO SMART' wordmark are gone (probably white text on a white background), and the logo outline floats almost invisible on white. On top of that, the blue panel is an empty chopped shape, the diagonal stripes cut across the hand photo, and the photo sits in an arbitrary inset with no alignment to anything else.
